title: Protocol for Initial Evaluation of Implanted Pacemaker

blocks.text: A 2-month recovery period is required after pacemaker implantation to allow for recovery and stabilization. After the 2-month recovery period, submit the following:
blocks.html: A 2-month recovery period is required after pacemaker implantation to allow for recovery and stabilization. After the 2-month recovery period, submit the following:

blocks.text: 1. Hospital records. Copies of hospital admission summary medical records pertaining to pacemaker. This includes history and physical, operative report, discharge summary, coronary catheterization or ischemia work up (if performed), and all ECG tracings. Pacemaker information must include the make of the generator and leads, model, and serial number.
blocks.html: 1. Hospital records. Copies of hospital admission summary medical records pertaining to pacemaker. This includes history and physical, operative report, discharge summary, coronary catheterization or ischemia work up (if performed), and all ECG tracings. Pacemaker information must include the make of the generator and leads, model, and serial number.

blocks.text: 2. Cardiology narrative. A typed narrative or clinical note from your cardiologist detailing your interim and current cardiac condition, functional capacity, medical history, and medications. It must also include:
blocks.html: 2. Cardiology narrative. A typed narrative or clinical note from your cardiologist detailing your interim and current cardiac condition, functional capacity, medical history, and medications. It must also include:

blocks.text: a. Evaluation of pacemaker function, programmed pacemaker parameters, exclusion of myopotential inhibition and pacemaker induced hypotension (pacemaker syndrome), elective replacement indicator/end of life (ERI/EOL), and battery voltage.
blocks.html: a. Evaluation of pacemaker function, programmed pacemaker parameters, exclusion of myopotential inhibition and pacemaker induced hypotension (pacemaker syndrome), elective replacement indicator/end of life (ERI/EOL), and battery voltage.

blocks.text: b. Pacemaker Status Summary *
blocks.html: b. Pacemaker Status Summary *

blocks.text: 3. Lab. Hemoglobin A1c and current blood lipid profile to include total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, and triglycerides.
blocks.html: 3. Lab. Hemoglobin A1c and current blood lipid profile to include total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, and triglycerides.

blocks.text: 4. Cardiac monitor. A current Holter monitor or similar evaluation for at least 24-consecutive hours to include select representative tracings. It must list:
blocks.html: 4. Cardiac monitor. A current Holter monitor or similar evaluation for at least 24-consecutive hours to include select representative tracings. It must list:

blocks.text: a. Atrial and ventricular ectopic counts/burden;
blocks.html: a. Atrial and ventricular ectopic counts/burden;

blocks.text: b. Hourly tabular data to include the longest pause duration and counts of all pauses >2.0 or 2.5 seconds;
blocks.html: b. Hourly tabular data to include the longest pause duration and counts of all pauses >2.0 or 2.5 seconds;

blocks.text: c. Heart rate (max and min), other day-by-day histograms, and frequency graphs; and
blocks.html: c. Heart rate (max and min), other day-by-day histograms, and frequency graphs; and

blocks.text: d. Percentage of time in atrial fibrillation/flutter
blocks.html: d. Percentage of time in atrial fibrillation/flutter

blocks.text: 5. Echo. A current M-mode, 2-dimensional echocardiogram with Doppler.
blocks.html: 5. Echo. A current M-mode, 2-dimensional echocardiogram with Doppler.

blocks.text: 6. Stress test. A current Maximal Graded Exercise Stress Test Requirements (GXT). If a radionuclide stress (RS) or cardiac angiogram (cardiac catheterization) were performed, submit those images and reports. Due to poor image quality, Xeroxed or faxed images will not be accepted.
blocks.html: 6. Stress test. A current Maximal Graded Exercise Stress Test Requirements (GXT). If a radionuclide stress (RS) or cardiac angiogram (cardiac catheterization) were performed, submit those images and reports. Due to poor image quality, Xeroxed or faxed images will not be accepted.

blocks.text: Note: Evaluation of Pacemaker Dependency is no longer required for any class as of 08/25/2021.
blocks.html: Note: Evaluation of Pacemaker Dependency is no longer required for any class as of 08/25/2021.

blocks.text: It is the responsibility of each applicant to provide the medical information required to determine his/her eligibility for airman medical certification.
blocks.html: It is the responsibility of each applicant to provide the medical information required to determine his/her eligibility for airman medical certification.
